prompt: State the physical quantity represented by the area bounded by a velocity-time graph and the time axis.
hints: Consider what quantity is obtained by multiplying velocity by time.
solution: Displacement (or distance in a specified direction).
teacher_walkthrough: Step 1: Recall the definition of velocity: rate of change of displacement.
Step 2: The product of velocity and time gives displacement.
Step 3: State displacement clearly, noting that it is a vector.

mark_scheme.criterion: Displacement (allow distance in a specified direction; do not allow distance alone)
